/customer-information/.title: Quotations, Orders & Service Guidance
/customer-information/.intro: Understand the steps between an enquiry, an agreed quotation and an officially confirmed service.

sections.title: Your request is the beginning
paragraphs: Choose the relevant service, describe your garment or assistance needs, and request a quotation. Sending a request or choosing a design does not confirm production, payment or availability.

sections.title: From enquiry to production
paragraphs: The sequence is: customer enquiry; quotation; customer acceptance; required payment; availability and final sourcing checks; official order confirmation; a separate official production-start notice; production and fitting; final balance; collection or delivery.

Standard order-confirmation target: 24 hours after the required steps are complete. Express order-confirmation target: 2 hours after the required steps are complete. These are confirmation targets, not garment-completion promises.

sections.title: Hours and overnight requests
paragraphs: Normal operating hours are 09:00–17:00 Kigali time. Requests for work after 22:00 are individually reviewed and quoted; there is no universal overnight surcharge. Confirm visit and work availability before relying on arrangements.

sections.title: Your communications and updates
paragraphs: Customer Support operates Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00 Kigali time, excluding Rwandan public holidays. The first-response target is within 24 support working hours, not 24 consecutive clock hours and not a refund-payment deadline.

The team communicates about quotations, payment confirmation, fabric availability, official production start, important changes, fittings, garment readiness, final payment and delivery or collection. If an interruption arises, its effect on the agreed completion date is assessed before a delay is announced. Confirmed issues and realistic revised arrangements are then discussed. This website does not provide live order tracking.

/guides/fabrics/.title: Fabric Guide
/guides/fabrics/.intro: Choose fabric and colour with clear expectations before your order is confirmed.

sections.title: Start with your garment and preferences
paragraphs: Tell us the garment, occasion, preferred feel, colour and style. Suitability and availability are assessed for the actual garment and quotation.

sections.title: Reference pictures are not stock guarantees
paragraphs: A photograph on this website does not guarantee that the exact fabric, finish or colour is available. We check availability and discuss suitable alternatives. Research images and visual comparisons are not laboratory-confirmed fabric composition.

sections.title: Agree alternatives before sourcing
paragraphs: If you request another colour or fabric, the team assesses suitability and availability. A change may require a revised quotation and customer agreement. We do not substitute fabric without your agreement.

sections.title: Fabric tiers and package prices
paragraphs: Ask for the confirmed fabric category, garment composition, package inclusions and quotation. Men’s tuxedos have separate packages and quotations; ordinary suit inclusions must not be assumed.

sections.title: Care and customer-supplied fabric
paragraphs: Follow the care label and the guidance confirmed for the chosen fabric. Customer-supplied fabric may be discussed for assessment. Quantity, condition, suitability, materials and conditions must be agreed individually.

/measurements/.title: Measurements Guide
/measurements/.intro: Accurate measurements help the team plan your garment and fitting arrangements. You can begin an enquiry before you have measurements.

sections.title: Prepare for measurement assistance
paragraphs: Describe the garment and intended fit, and tell us whether you already have measurements or need guidance. Wear suitable everyday clothing for an agreed appointment and discuss any practical needs with the team. Confirm which measurements are needed for your garment; no universal numerical tolerance is promised.

sections.title: Provide information carefully
paragraphs: Use the measurement instructions supplied for your garment. Confirm units and who took the measurements, and check for missing or unclear information before sending. The team will clarify incomplete information and arrange professional assistance or a fitting where applicable.

sections.title: Measurements and fitting appointments
paragraphs: Consultation, measurements, fittings and any location visit are individually arranged. Confirm the date, place, garment requirements and quotation. Do not assume a visit or fitting is confirmed simply because a form was sent.

sections.title: If supplied measurements are incorrect
paragraphs: Tell us promptly about a concern. We assess whether correction is feasible and discuss the approved assistance arrangements. A replacement garment may require a separate quotation where appropriate; not every incorrect customer-supplied measurement can be corrected.

sections.title: If Mr Sewing makes an error
paragraphs: Mr Sewing assesses its own fitting or workmanship errors and corrects feasible errors without an additional tailoring charge. A remake at the company’s expense may be appropriate if proper correction is impossible. This does not exclude applicable customer rights or legal remedies.

sections.title: Report a fitting concern
paragraphs: Report concerns promptly, preferably through official WhatsApp, with order details and a description. The documented guidance is within 72 hours after receipt or collection. This guidance is not a cutoff for statutory rights. Arrange assessment rather than relying on an automatic acceptance of a claim.

/delivery-and-collection/.title: Delivery, Collection & Storage
/delivery-and-collection/.intro: Agree the practical handover arrangements and check your ready notification.

sections.title: Included and separately agreed arrangements
paragraphs: The documented standard Kigali custom-suit package includes initial standard cleaning, protective packaging and initial Kigali delivery. Included services are not charged again. Additional delivery and outside-Kigali arrangements require an agreed quotation where applicable; no shipping cost or delivered-by deadline is assumed.
{{policyTransport}}

sections.title: Before dispatch
paragraphs: The team confirms the delivery address and time, verifies required payment and records delivery completion. Customers should provide accurate contact and address details and be available for the agreed arrangements.

sections.title: Changes and unsuccessful delivery
paragraphs: The documented rescheduling policy allows at least one hour’s notice. Later changes or failed delivery may involve justified approved additional costs, agreed as applicable; no automatic flat fee is published. If the company causes a missed delivery, contact Support for the applicable business-responsibility arrangements. The exact reimbursement/remedy rule still requires source reconciliation; do not assume a customer-caused fee applies.

sections.title: Collection and authorised collectors
paragraphs: Collection requires full payment where applicable and appropriate identity or collection verification. Another collector needs written authorisation. A collection receipt and notification to the original customer are used where applicable. Do not send ID scans through this website form.

sections.title: Storage after readiness
paragraphs: Seven calendar days of free storage run from the ready notification. Any extension needs individual approval and written confirmation. No daily storage penalty, garment forfeiture, abandonment or resale condition is published.

/benefits/.title: Suit Benefits, Loyalty & Referrals
/benefits/.intro: Approved customer discounts apply to qualifying suits, not automatically to unrelated services. Confirm eligibility with the team.

sections.title: Loyalty
paragraphs: A 3% discount begins with the second separate qualifying suit purchase.

sections.title: Referral customer discount
paragraphs: An eligible new referred customer receives 2% off qualifying suits in their first qualifying order. Referral attribution and edge-case procedures are not fully published; confirm participation and eligibility with the team before relying on a benefit.

sections.title: Referrer commission
paragraphs: The approved rate is 6,000 RWF per qualifying suit in the referred customer’s first qualifying order, subject to the approved commission conditions. Attribution, verification and payment procedures require confirmation; this page does not promise automatic eligibility or a payout date.

sections.title: Bulk and group
paragraphs: {{policyBulk}}
Group: 3% for qualifying suit orders placed together by at least two customers, subject to the documented request conditions. Ask the team to confirm those request conditions before ordering.

sections.title: How customer discounts combine
paragraphs: Customer discounts do not stack on the same suit. Use the single highest eligible customer discount. Referral commission is separate from the customer’s discount.

sections.title: Enquiries, quotations and acceptance
paragraphs: A website enquiry, chosen design or acknowledgement is not a confirmed order. Review the quotation, design, fabric, measurements, price and relevant conditions. Customer acceptance, required payment, availability/sourcing checks and official confirmation are separate steps; production also has a separate official start notice.

sections.title: Corrections and workmanship
paragraphs: Report fitting/workmanship concerns promptly, preferably via WhatsApp; documented guidance is within 72 hours after receipt/collection without limiting statutory rights. Mr Sewing assesses company-caused errors, corrects feasible errors without an additional tailoring charge and may provide a company-funded remake if proper correction is impossible. Customer-supplied measurement errors need feasibility assessment; a replacement may need a separate quote.

sections.title: Complaints and refund requests
paragraphs: Use Customer Support or the refund request form with order details, reason and relevant evidence. Human review and a decision are required; submission does not approve a refund. No automatic percentage deduction, deposit forfeiture, Express-fee retention, universal penalty or guaranteed processing deadline is imposed here. Cancellation and refund arrangements are assessed individually; request clarification before accepting your quotation.

/refund-policy/.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
/refund-policy/.intro: Submit a request for human assessment. An enquiry or form acknowledgement is not an approved refund.

sections.title: How to request a review
paragraphs: Use the request form below or official WhatsApp/email. Provide the order or quotation reference, your contact details, the issue, relevant dates and the remedy requested. Describe any receipt, payment or garment evidence you can supply; the team will explain how to share it. Do not send card details, payment PINs or ID scans.

sections.title: Review and decision
paragraphs: Support reviews the request with the relevant team, seeks clarification if needed and communicates the decision through WhatsApp or email. You may ask for further assistance or clarification. First-response guidance is within 24 support working hours during Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 Kigali time excluding Rwandan public holidays; this is not a refund-payment deadline.

sections.title: Fitting and workmanship concerns
paragraphs: Report promptly, preferably through WhatsApp. The documented guidance is within 72 hours after receipt/collection, without limiting statutory rights. Mr Sewing corrects feasible company-caused fitting/workmanship errors without an additional tailoring charge and may remake at company expense if proper correction is impossible. Other remedies remain subject to applicable customer rights.

sections.title: Customer-provided measurements
paragraphs: Correction feasibility is assessed. Not every supplied-measurement error can be corrected; an appropriate replacement may require a separate quotation under the applicable approved assistance arrangements.

sections.title: Cancellation and changes
paragraphs: Tell us promptly if you wish to cancel or change an order, service or visit. Include whether a quotation has been accepted, payment has been made, materials have been committed or work has started. Changes require feasibility, quotation and scheduling agreement before the team proceeds.

The team assesses your request and supporting information and communicates its decision. Submitting a request does not itself approve a refund or fix a deduction or payment date. These procedures do not remove applicable customer rights.

/privacy-policy/.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy-policy/.intro: Learn how Mr Sewing Fashion uses information provided through this website and how to contact us about your privacy.

sections.title: Who operates the website
paragraphs: Mr Sewing Fashion is the public brand of NINKONIYUMUTWARE NEXUS LTD, Kigali, Rwanda. Contact the business through the official email, phone or WhatsApp listed on the Contact page for privacy questions or requests.

sections.title: Information you provide
paragraphs: Quotation, support and refund forms collect the name, phone and optional email needed to respond, relevant location, selected service/preferences and your message. Design, measurement, address, order-reference and payment-related evidence may be discussed with the team as relevant. Do not enter payment PINs, full card details or identity scans in these forms.

sections.title: Forms, hosting and messaging
paragraphs: The website uses GitHub Pages for public-page deployment and Cloudflare Pages for text-enquiry validation and staging. Text enquiries are processed through Web3Forms, either directly or after validation. A successful provider response does not prove mailbox receipt. Hosting and network services process requests needed to operate the site. Choosing a WhatsApp, email, social or external link uses the relevant provider; its processing is separate from this website.

sections.title: Reference files and measurements
paragraphs: Website file uploads are disabled in the public forms. No reference files are attached to text enquiries. Customers may arrange reference or measurement sharing with the team through official communication channels.

The public forms do not use private website request or file storage in this release. A submission acknowledgement does not confirm a privately stored website record. Contact the business about the retention and deletion arrangements applicable to information shared through its providers and communication channels.

sections.title: Selections, cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The website keeps service/design/fabric choices in per-tab browser session storage. Quotation forms also keep a temporary per-tab draft of contact and request fields so navigation or editing need not lose your work. The code checks for a draft older than 30 minutes when reopening the form and clears it after an accepted submission; this is not a server or email-retention period. Browser storage can be unavailable, and a saved draft is not a submitted request.

Existing cart code can save product selections, not payment credentials, in browser local storage. Current enquiry-only Shop products do not activate a purchasing cart. No new analytics, advertising tracker or cookie-consent system is introduced by these changes. Legacy pages may load Font Awesome from cdnjs.cloudflare.com. Actual deployed cookies and external-provider practices require separate verification.

sections.title: Purposes and sharing
paragraphs: Information is used to assess requests, prepare quotations, communicate with you, arrange services, review complaints and provide requested follow-up. Hosting, form-submission, email and messaging providers process information needed for their part of these communications. A website enquiry is not permission to publish your photograph or testimonial.

sections.title: Privacy questions and requests
paragraphs: Contact Mr Sewing Fashion through the official contact details for questions about access, correction, deletion or other applicable privacy rights. Explain the request and relevant enquiry reference without sending passwords, payment PINs or unnecessary identity documents.

Data retention, provider processing and any international-transfer arrangements depend on the systems actually used and applicable requirements. This policy does not promise an unverified retention period, security certification or automatic deletion across email and messaging providers.

sections.title: Support schedule

sections.title: What we can help clarify
paragraphs: Ask about enquiries, quotations, measurements, fabric availability, order details, delivery/collection, fittings, complaints, refund procedures or follow-up assistance. sections.title: A clear, personal process

sections.title: Photographs and company information

/contact/.title: Contact Mr Sewing Fashion

sections.title: Location
paragraphs: Main workshop: KN 441 St, Norvège, Nyarugenge, Kigali, Rwanda. The existing MIC Building, Downtown consultation location is by appointment; confirm arrangements with the team. These are retained repository contact records, not a new branch or staffed-location claim.

sections.title: Hours
paragraphs: Normal service hours: 09:00–17:00 Kigali time. Standard after-hours work 17:00–22:00 is subject to availability and quotation. Work after 22:00 is individually reviewed. Confirm workshop visit days and availability with the team.

sections.title: Customer Support
paragraphs: Support operates Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00 Kigali time excluding Rwandan public holidays. The first-response target is within 24 support working hours. Support hours and production/after-hours availability are different schedules.

services.title: Custom Tailoring & Suits
services.intro: Personalised garment design, fabric preferences, measurements and fitting arrangements for your individual tailoring request.
sections: Your style, your fit

Discuss design preferences, fabric selection, measurements, consultation, quotation, production, fitting and delivery arrangements. Browse Men’s or Women’s Suits and select a website design, or use the Special Order alternative for your own inspiration. Fabric preferences or advice and Standard/Express Priority follow.
Suits and garment scope

Men’s suits include two-piece garments (jacket and trousers), three-piece garments (jacket, trousers and waistcoat), business and ceremony styles, and men’s tuxedos. Women’s two- and three-piece business and ceremony styles are discussed for your requirements.
Packages and quotations
Men’s tuxedos have separate package inclusions and quotations. We confirm the fabric category, garment composition, availability, accessories and package inclusions in your quotation.
Payment and confirmation
{{policyDomesticPayment}} {{policyInternationalPayment}} {{policyPaymentVerification}}

services.title: Clothing Alterations & Repairs
services.intro: Discuss adjustments to fit and repairs to clothing, assessed against the garment’s condition and the change you need.
sections: Describe the garment and work

Tell us the garment type, current fit or damage, requested change and relevant previous repairs. The team assesses condition, materials and feasibility before quoting; not every garment can be repaired.
Fitting and handover

Measurements or fitting assistance may be arranged where relevant. Collection, delivery, timing and any approved visit are individually confirmed. The final alteration price depends on inspection, complexity and the accepted quotation.
Choose your assistance

Standard Service uses established arrangements. VIP requests for personalised or cross-service/on-location assistance are individually assessed and quoted. Choose Standard or Express Priority separately; priority is not a service package.

services.title: Garment Care & Cleaning
services.intro: Request an assessment of suitable care for your garment, its care label, condition and individual requirements.
sections: The garment comes first

Describe the item, care label, fabric information you know, stains/damage and previous treatment. The team confirms which approved available care option is suitable. Not every fabric is suitable for every process.
Confirm the actual service
The team explains the suitable available method, care requirements and limitations before quoting. Confirm the actual service, charges and timing before handing over a garment.
Collection and assistance

Collection, delivery and priority requests require confirmation. Initial standard cleaning in the standard suit package is not charged twice. Additional cleaning, visits and transport are confirmed in the quotation.

services.title: Mobile Tailoring, Styling & Event Assistance
services.intro: Individually arranged assistance for tailoring consultation, measurements, fitting, styling and garment needs around an event or location.
sections: Tell us where and what you need

Describe your home, workplace or event location, the garment or styling need, preferred timing and practical requirements. On-location consultation, measurements, fittings and event-related assistance are assessed individually.
Availability and scope
Location, timing, staffing, feasibility and quotation must be confirmed. Not every request can be accepted. A form or selected date is not a confirmed visit or event commitment.
Your own service, or coordinated assistance

This remains its own official service, including when a customer requests location assistance through tailoring, alterations or care. Personalised VIP requests have their own service entry point. Standard or Express Priority is considered where applicable, and any agreed cross-service scope is confirmed in the quotation.

services.title: VIP Services
services.intro: Personalised assistance, individually assessed and arranged through an agreed quotation.
sections: Personalised service requests
Describe the tailoring, alterations, garment-care, styling or on-location assistance you need. Location, scope, timing and feasibility require confirmation.
Your agreed VIP quotation

Approved Express and after-hours assistance is assessed within the agreed VIP scope and quotation. Ordinary-service surcharges are not automatically applied. No unlimited service or completion guarantee is offered.
